news.title: Man found dead after shots fired report in Gwinnett County
news.summary: Officers responded to a report of gunshots in a Gwinnett County neighborhood on Sunday evening and discovered a man dead at the scene.

news.title: At least one dead after DeKalb County shooting
news.summary: At least one person died after a shooting late Sunday on Treasure Cove, where investigators removed two vehicles from the scene.

news.title: Man found dead outside Tucker apartment building after reports of gunfire, police say
news.summary: Gwinnett County police are investigating after a man was found dead outside a Tucker apartment building following reports of gunfire.

news.title: Man found shot in apartment parking lot dies
news.summary: Gwinnett County PD are conducting an investigation into a deadly shooting in an apartment complex in Tucker Sunday night.

news.title: Machete-wielding man tries to steal man’s car at Atlanta airport, police say
news.summary: He says the encounter happened Thursday afternoon near the airport’s cellphone lot.

news.title: 7-month-old girl among two killed in 10-vehicle crash after police chase on I-20 in DeKalb County
news.summary: Three infants in one of the vehicles struck were taken to Children’s Healthcare of Atlanta. One later died from her injuries.

news.title: Baby dies after Georgia police chase ends in 10-car crash on I-20
news.summary: A 7-month-old girl died Saturday night after a high-speed pursuit on Interstate 20 led to a 10-vehicle crash in DeKalb County, according to officials.

news.title: Baby killed in multi-vehicle crash on I-20, at-fault driver dies: GSP
news.summary: A driver involved in a chase with Georgia State Patrol crashed on Interstate 20 and Wesley Chapel Road exit ramp. A 7-month-old died in the crash.
